templates.diagnosisTemplate: Price pressure lands harder when Positioning is low. A business that owns its positioning competes on value, not price.
Cash flow gaps hit hardest when Capital is low. Financial runway changes what is strategically possible.

templates.template: Your {ROLE} just accepted an offer from {DESTINATION}.
templates.diagnosisTemplate: Losing a key person exposes how much knowledge lives in heads instead of systems. A documented process survives the person who built it.
Market shifts are invisible until they are obvious. High Information Asymmetry means you see them before your competitors do.
Negative signals spread faster than positive ones. A strong Communications position means your existing customers defend you before you have to.
Cost surprises reveal how thin your margins actually are. Capital reserves are not savings — they are strategic options.

templates.template: A competitor just launched {COPY} of your core offering.
templates.diagnosisTemplate: Being copied means you were worth copying. The question is whether your Differentiation runs deep enough that the copy cannot feel the same.

templates.template: Repeat purchase rate dropped {PERCENT}% this quarter with no clear cause.
templates.diagnosisTemplate: Customers who loved the first experience but did not return were never habituated. The trigger to come back was never built.

templates.template: Quality dropped {PERCENT}% as volume increased this month.
templates.diagnosisTemplate: Quality that depends on the owner's presence cannot scale. A system that delivers the same outcome at any volume is the only thing that can grow.

templates.template: A competitor moved into your market {TIMING} and captured first-mover advantage.

TIMING: with a smaller budget but faster execution

templates.diagnosisTemplate: Timing is a lever. Too early means educating the market for someone else. Too late means fighting for scraps. Information Asymmetry is what tells you which one you are facing.

noiseEvents.label: INFLATION SPIKE
noiseEvents.description: Operating costs rising across the board.

noiseEvents.label: ALGORITHM CHANGE
noiseEvents.description: Your primary channel just changed the rules.

noiseEvents.label: SUPPLY DISRUPTION
noiseEvents.description: Your supply chain has a new bottleneck.
